_meta.description: Development threads — the project's long-running lines of work, tracked as first-class rows. Rendered at /threads in the encyclopedia; git activity is matched live via each thread's regex patterns. Seeded 2026-07-13 from the four-month blog synthesis (2026-03-13 → 2026-07-13). Hand-edit freely: progress numbers, open items, and match patterns are all data.

threads.title: The Book
threads.summary: Rulings are the source, prose is compiled (trench protocol); baseline contracts pick each chapter's cast; heroes/anti-heroes carry the dialectic. The instrument is finished — what remains is the writing.

threads.title: Space Automation (maps)
threads.summary: The map is engine-neutral data; the engine is a swappable renderer. Wang-tile room contracts make maps connected by construction; the mission graph seeds rooms from teaching beats; the map simulator edits live and saves validated map_data.json.

openItems.text: Second renderer (Three.js) of map_data.json — two projections of one spec keep each other honest
Registry-honesty punch list (47 benches)

threads.title: Artifact Staging (types + em-square)
threads.summary: Eight staging types in staging_dna.json give ~2,570 artifacts a considered home — improve the type, not the room. The em-square (anchor, rest pose, base contact) lets one layout engine seat everything without looking inside it.

openItems.text: Walk the 205 detected monuments in auto-discover; accept/reject each classification

threads.title: Catalyst, Friends & Hazards
threads.summary: The danger system became one system: friend conversions grant persistent player powers (ten modes, lineage-tracked), chambers unlock at theme events mid-sequence, and the pathfinder is hazard-aware. The powers are still registered fiction.

openItems.text: Implement in-world effects for the ten friend powers (shield parts flames, porter crosses pits…)
Adopt hazard rooms into sequences 1–6: give Lab_Death and Zone_ForbiddenWetLab corridors
The QFEP reunion room where all ten powers matter

threads.title: The Seams (bias landscape)
threads.summary: One seam artifact per sequence — the exact place that domain's continuous or infinite ideal is counterfeited by the cheap and discrete. The law underneath: bias is conserved; show the seam.

openItems.text: Place the seams into their sequences' maps — met mid-walk, not browsed in a gallery
Headset TRNG artifact (hardware_entropy_decay): harvest IMU/camera/body noise — the argument walked
The two unbuilt seams: build or declare as blanks with empty plinths

threads.title: Commons Ledger & Provenance
threads.summary: The standing fourth question: whose knowledge is this pressed from — does the walk return it or enclose it? Candidate sources auto-credit makers the moment their pattern is built. The first weaver has a name: Kristina Torsson, credited as origin.

openItems.text: Build loom_kente, loom_ikat, mill_iznik — each auto-credits its makers on arrival
Decide what part of Ada's text and tooling passes into common hands; write the schedule into the work

threads.title: VR Walking (the bottleneck)
threads.summary: Nearly every spine sequence sits at pipeline stage 6 unwalked. Gaze-ride lets the machine pre-walk, but the headset walk is the one thing only a body can do — and it is what promotes chapters from draft to more-than-draft.

openItems.text: The five-sequence playable slice (primitives → randomness) as the demo of the pedagogical bet
Walk symmetry and form-finding
Feed VR bridge feedback into the chapters (reader_comments + desktop_feedback)

threads.title: J-Space (walkable hidden layer)
threads.summary: The book's LSA space as walkable rooms — the chamber, the endless ring, the web scroll twin. Fidelity and legibility trade openly: the projection's error is posted on a plaque (stress-1 = 0.27), and the walk rents the missing dimensions through time.
